gameplayFunction: primary defendable objective and visual anchor
oneSecondRead: This tall protected glowing heart is the thing the fortress exists to defend, and its current health can be read from across the battlefield.
worldRole: The fortress heart, battle objective and persistent visual anchor that converts abstract survival into protection of a player-authored home.
emotionalIntent: Precious, resilient and worth rallying around; damage should feel alarming but legible, never arbitrary or hopeless.

orientation.front: A tall protected luminous heart framed by buttresses and a readable opening that invites defense and interaction.
orientation.playerSide: A complete protected ring and accessible lower service band identify friendly interaction without resembling a weapon.
orientation.threatSide: Protective rings open, buttresses fail and the core becomes more exposed as health worsens.

interactionZones.purpose: Make the objective a stable fortress landmark.

interactionZones.purpose: Communicate objective life and health without UI dependence.
interactionZones.requiredCue: Protected central core with changing exposure. Brightest controlled region. Color role: interaction.

interactionZones.purpose: Show how well the objective remains defended.
interactionZones.requiredCue: Rings and buttresses close when intact and open or break with damage. Mid-value protective shell. Color role: secondary.

interactionZones.purpose: Show the player-facing repair and interaction approach.
interactionZones.requiredCue: One deliberate opening and complete interaction ring. High contrast against pedestal. Color role: accent.

collisionPromise: Keep the bottom_center pivot, footprint and gameplay anchors identical in every generated state.
obligations: Reconstruct every primary and secondary component defined by this canon.
Produce every required state from the same component structure and stable anchors.
Preserve the one-second function, front, interaction, danger and state readings.
Record this canon ID and exact SHA-256 in the compliance envelope.
constraints: Dimensions are 6.0 x 7.0 x 6.0 studs with tolerance 0.005.
Pivot is bottom_center and component anchors remain stable.
One UV set and one material slot maximum per production mesh component.
freedoms: historical_repairs: zero to three large approved repair marks. Supports persistent fortress history without introducing noisy damage.
buttress_profile: territory-approved radial profile only. Allows DA expression while preserving the protected-center logic.
core_pulse_phase: bounded asynchronous phase across repeated cores. Avoids robotic synchronization without changing state meaning.
prohibitions: weapon barrel or hostile aiming cue
unprotected glowing sphere with no construction logic
full radial symmetry that erases front and rear
uniform cracks or grime over the entire monument
text, logos or unexplained sacred symbols
decorative repair with no causal reason
more than three visible material families
literal construction-toy motifs or pristine molded-plastic identity
